pages.ko: 호야는 가장 아끼는 노란 토끼 인형을 안고 마당에서 아장아장 놀았어요. "토끼야, 우리 뛰어 볼까?" 호야는 인형을 꼭 안고 신나서 폴짝폴짝 뛰었어요.
pages.t: Hoya toddled around the yard, hugging her favorite yellow bunny doll. "Bunny, shall we run together?" Hoya hugged the doll tight and hopped around happily.

pages.ko: 그런데 폴짝 뛰다가— 꽈당! 호야가 잔디에 넘어졌어요. 무릎이 따끔! 게다가 손에서 노란 토끼 인형이 데구루루 굴러 웅덩이에 풍덩 빠졌어요. 호야의 눈이 그렁그렁해졌어요.
pages.t: But while hopping along—thump! Hoya tripped and fell on the grass. Her knee stung! And worse, the yellow bunny doll rolled right out of her hands and plopped into a puddle. Hoya's eyes filled with tears.

pages.ko: 눈물이 왈칵 나오려는데, 호야는 꾹 참았어요. "우, 울면 아기 같으니까…" 입술을 앙 깨물고 눈을 질끈 감았어요. 그런데 참을수록 목이 메고 가슴이 답답해지기만 했어요.
pages.t: The tears were about to burst out, but Hoya held them back. "C-crying is for babies..." She bit her lip and squeezed her eyes shut. But the more she held it in, the more her throat tightened and her chest felt heavy.

pages.ko: 그때 엄마가 조르르 달려왔어요. "호야야, 많이 아팠지?" 엄마는 호야 앞에 무릎을 굽혀 눈을 맞췄어요. "울음이 나오려고 하는구나. 참지 않아도 돼."
pages.t: Just then, Mom hurried over. "Hoya, that must have really hurt." Mom knelt down in front of Hoya and looked her in the eye. "Looks like you want to cry. You don't have to hold it in."

pages.ko: 엄마가 다정하게 말했어요. "무릎도 아프고, 토끼도 젖어서 속상하지? 그건 '슬픈 마음'이야. 슬플 땐 울어도 괜찮아. 우는 건 하나도 부끄러운 게 아니란다."
pages.t: Mom spoke gently. "Your knee hurts, and your bunny got wet, that's upsetting, isn't it? That's called feeling sad. It's okay to cry when you're sad. There's nothing embarrassing about crying at all."

pages.ko: 엄마가 두 팔을 활짝 벌렸어요. "이리 와, 엄마 품에서 실컷 울어도 돼." 그 말에 호야는 참았던 울음이 왈칵— "으아앙!" 엄마 품에 폭 안겨 마음껏 울었어요. "울어도 괜찮아, 안아줄게."
pages.t: Mom spread her arms open wide. "Come here, you can cry as much as you want in Mom's arms." At those words, all the tears Hoya had held back came pouring out—"Waaah!" She buried herself in Mom's arms and cried to her heart's content. "It's okay to cry, I've got you."

pages.ko: 한참 울고 나니, 어라? 답답하던 가슴이 뻥— 뚫린 것 같아요! "이제… 괜찮아진 것 같아." 호야는 훌쩍이며 엄마 품에서 빠끔 얼굴을 들었어요. 엄마가 눈물을 닦아 줬어요. "울어도 괜찮아, 안아줄게."
pages.t: After crying for a good while, huh? The tightness in her chest felt like it had cleared right up! "I think... I feel better now." Sniffling, Hoya peeked her face up from Mom's arms. Mom wiped away her tears. "It's okay to cry, I've got you."

pages.ko: 형 호리가 노란 토끼 인형을 주워 와 깨끗이 닦아 줬어요. "자, 토끼 여기 있어!" 호야는 인형을 다시 꼭 안았어요. 울고 나니 마음이 맑아져서, 얼굴에 뽀송한 웃음이 활짝 피어났어요.
pages.t: Her big brother Hori picked up the yellow bunny doll and wiped it clean. "Here, here's your bunny!" Hoya hugged the doll tight again. After crying, her heart felt clear, and a fresh, bright smile bloomed across her face.

pages.ko: 이제 호야는 알아요. 슬플 땐 이렇게 해요. 하나, "슬퍼"라고 말하기! 둘, 참지 말고 울기! 셋, 안아 달라고 하기! 며칠 뒤 호야가 또 속상한 일이 생기자, 스스로 엄마에게 갔어요. "엄마, 나 슬퍼. 안아 줘."
pages.t: Now Hoya knows what to do when she feels sad. One, say "I'm sad"! Two, cry instead of holding it in! Three, ask for a hug! A few days later, when something upset Hoya again, she went straight to Mom on her own. "Mom, I'm sad. Hug me."

pages.ko: 엄마가 호야를 폭 안아 주었어요. "울고 싶을 땐 울어도 돼. 다 울고 나면 마음이 개운해지니까." 호야는 이제 알아요. 슬픈 마음도 소중하다는 걸. 울어도 괜찮아, 안아줄게.
pages.t: Mom wrapped Hoya in a big hug. "When you feel like crying, it's okay to cry. Once you're done, your heart will feel light again." Now Hoya knows that sad feelings matter too. It's okay to cry, I've got you.

overview.ko: 슬픔을 억지로 참던 호리가 마음껏 울고 위로받으며 감정을 건강하게 표현하는 법을 배우는 감정 동화입니다.
overview.t: An emotional story about Hori, who used to force back sad feelings, learning to express emotions in a healthy way by crying freely and being comforted.

lessons.t: Express sadness instead of holding it in.
Understand that it's okay to cry.

readingTips.t: Read the refrain 'It's okay to cry' in a warm, soothing voice.

readingTips.ko: 아이가 슬플 때 충분히 공감해 주세요.
readingTips.t: When your child feels sad, be sure to fully empathize with them.
